name: kar-driftscore
purpose: Scores how far a model's inputs have drifted: one number from 0 (identical) to 1 (nothing shared) between two label-count distributions, the total variation distance, with no AI judge.

lane.accepts: two label-count distributions (what the model used to see, what it sees now), each with non-negative counts and a total above zero
lane.refuses: anything that is not two scorable distributions, such as raw text, a single list, negative or empty counts, or a request to retrain a model

interface.out: the drift score from 0 to 1, or a refusal saying which count is wrong

judge.what: a claimed drift score is right when DriftScore's own kernel recomputes the same total variation distance for those two distributions, to six decimal places
